note: Sector starter packs (spec section 19). A pack is a curated emphasis - it re-weights the compliance profile and pre-selects frameworks/controls to focus on first. It never hides other frameworks and never asserts applicability the company facts don't support. HIPAA is intentionally absent (not implemented in the platform - do not invent it).

packs.name: B2B AI SaaS
packs.description: The default for a 10-250 person company selling AI/software to enterprises.

packs.name: FinTech / InsurTech / RegTech
packs.description: Adds operational-resilience and supply-chain depth for companies in or selling to regulated finance.

packs.name: HealthTech
packs.description: Emphasises sensitive-data protection, human oversight and vendor governance. Does not add HIPAA (not implemented).

packs.name: HRTech / Recruitment AI
packs.description: For AI that supports employment decisions - high-risk under the EU AI Act.

packs.name: India IT / AI Services
packs.description: For Indian companies selling AI/software to EU, UK, Singapore or US enterprises.

packs.name: CRA / Connected Product
packs.description: For IoT / connected-hardware / embedded-software companies placing products on the EU market.
